payload.title: Release reviewed guidance through the existing portfolio overlay
payload.goal: Verify the intended BidetFit artifact and recovery without colliding with CommerceLint deployment.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Submit reviewed candidate to existing release owner; reserve pri8771/priyanshchordia.com:deployment with the existing four-bot parent. Wait only for an actual in-flight conflicting deployment, never all CommerceLint task completion.
Reuse bidetfit-pages-overlay.yml and existing build/mount; bind immutable portfolio source and mounted CommerceLint source to one artifact manifest.
Verify homepage, checker, source-backed outcome, measurement pages, disclosures, privacy, canonical/sitemap and both ventures critical routes.
Require eligibility validator for any newly activated tracking link; if approval missing release non-affiliate utility.
Rehearse prior-artifact restoration and public readback through same deployment owner; reconcile uncertain workflow status before retry.
tests: Conflicting portfolio deployment ownership blocks this effect only; fixture/browser work continues.
Wrong artifact/source hash, unsupported source claim or unapproved commercial link fails gate.
Rollback restores both CL and BF critical routes with saved receipt.
No approved merchant/program or commission report: non-affiliate checker release passes product gate and zero tracking links activate.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Independent review and public readback identify exact released source and useful complete checker journey.
Release with no active affiliate links is valid useful-product delivery; it does not establish commission or runtime autonomy.
payload.rollback: Existing deployment owner restores last reviewed combined artifact, preserving state/commission receipts.
payload.next_eligible_action: Prepare exact candidate and release evidence request for existing overlay owner.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Shared portfolio production destination is serialized; no worker schedule change is authorized by this plan.
